أذدكر (form VIII)
# أَذْدَكِرُ (ʔaḏdakiru) /ʔað.da.ki.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# أُذْدَكَرُ (ʔuḏdakaru) /ʔuð.da.ka.ru/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# أَذْدَكِرَ (ʔaḏdakira) /ʔað.da.ki.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِذْدَكَرَ (iḏdakara)
# أُذْدَكَرَ (ʔuḏdakara) /ʔuð.da.ka
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
